name: Tropius
description: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the foe. This attack will not miss.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the foe with its full body weight. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user sticks its head out and rams straight forward. It may make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
